# Geetanjali Home Appliances — Full Brand & Product Reference

## About the Brand
Geetanjali Home Appliances is a pressure cooker and cookware manufacturing brand manufactured by Harsh Home Appliances. The company is based at K-11, Bawana Industrial Area, Sector-2, Delhi - 110039, India, and has over 30 years of experience in manufacturing pressure cookers and cookware. Geetanjali products are ISI certified and the brand ships its products across all of India (pan-India delivery).

## Full Product Catalog

### Category: Pressure Cookers
Geetanjali manufactures pressure cookers in four distinct series, covering sizes from 1.5 litres to 22 litres, suitable for both small households and commercial/bulk use.

1. Trinity Series (Triply Pressure Cooker)
   Material: Triply construction (multi-layer metal for even heat distribution)
   Lid Types:
   - Inner Lid: available in Classic shape and Contura shape
   - Outer Lid: available in Regular shape and Handi shape

2. Stello Series (Stainless Steel Pressure Cooker)
   Material: Stainless steel
   Lid Types:
   - Inner Lid: available in Classic shape and Contura shape
   - Outer Lid: available in Regular shape and Handi shape

3. Black Beauty Series (Hard Anodized Pressure Cooker)
   Material: Hard anodized aluminium
   Lid Type: Inner Lid, Contura shape only

4. Alex Series (Aluminium Pressure Cooker)
   Material: Aluminium
   Lid Type: Outer Lid, Regular shape only

Size Range: All series available across sizes ranging from 1.5 litres to 22 litres.

### Category: Cookware
Geetanjali manufactures cookware in two main series:

1. Trident Series (Triply Cookware)
   Material: Triply construction
   Products: Kadhai, Tasra, Tope, Stewpan, Saucepan, Frypan

2. Tricomb Series (Triply Cookware with Honeycomb Non-Stick Coating)
   Material: Triply base with uniform honeycomb non-stick coating
   Products: Roti Tawa, Dosa Tawa, Frypan, Kadhai, Tasra

## Core Strengths / Flagship Products
- Triply Stainless Steel Pressure Cookers
- Triply Honeycomb Non-Stick Cookware
